description: Kits are coherent sets built to one palette and one grid. Reach for a kit when the user is building a whole environment rather than looking for one object. Each carries a status: "published" means every planned part is built, "filling-up" means parts are still landing — and the parts of a filling-up kit are usable TODAY. NO kit is sold as a bundle: price_usd is null and for_sale false on all of them, so never quote a kit price and never use those fields to tell the statuses apart. The parts come with a plan, free ones with no account. Use get_kit to fetch either.
name: list_kits
